name: Agent Approval Gate
description: When an agent asks permission: the exact command or diff, a risk tag, and Allow once, Always allow here or Deny. Keyboard first, with a timer that runs only while seen.

props.name: agent
props.description: Name of the agent asking. Shown in the eyebrow, the denial placeholder and the file-write note.

props.name: request
props.description: What the agent wants to do. Chooses the title, the exact command, the diff, the touch tag and the three facets.

props.name: risk
props.description: How serious the request is in its context. Colours the touch tag (medium uses its own amber, never the accent) and picks the note in its tooltip, which is written for each request.

props.name: showDiff
props.description: Show the diff under the command when the request has one. The command always shows.

props.name: countdown
props.description: Seconds until the request is denied on its own. 0 turns the countdown off. The clock runs only while the card is in view. It pauses while the pointer is over the card, while focus is on a control, while the card is off screen and while the tab is hidden, and it never starts unseen.

props.name: status
props.description: Drive the card from outside: pending resets it and clears an earlier answer; approved or denied folds it into the receipt.

props.name: onDecision
props.description: Called once with the answer: once, always (with its scope), deny (with an optional reason) or timeout.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one brand accent: the primary button, the countdown bar and the selected scope dot. Defaults to ink for the theme (near-white on dark, near-black on light), so the primary action is never amber. Passing either ink ("#f4f4f5" or "#111113") also means ink and follows the theme, which is why the default swatch stays correct in the light theme. The ink that sits on it is picked for contrast. Risk colours are fixed.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black card with white ink, or the white inverse.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the card once it is in view, so Y, A and N answer without a Tab. Shows a quiet outline on the card while the keys are live. The demo turns it on.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the card.

name: Agent Plan
description: A numbered agent plan you reorder and rename before approving, then watch tick through live with timings, a shimmer on the active step and substeps unfolding beneath it.

props.name: title
props.description: The goal the plan serves, in the display face.

props.name: summary
props.default: "Drafted from your request and the current schema. Nothing runs until you approve."
props.description: One line under the title while the plan is a draft.

props.name: steps
props.description: The proposed steps in order. { id, title, duration? (ms of real run time, shown as the estimate), substeps?, outcome?, reason? }. Keep the array stable between renders.

props.name: stepCount
props.description: How many of the steps to propose, from the top (3 to 8).

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled phase. Omit to let the plan manage its own run.

props.name: defaultState
props.description: Starting phase when uncontrolled.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Called on approve, pause, resume, retry, edit and when the run finishes or fails.

props.name: onApprove
props.description: Called with the steps in their final order and wording when the plan is approved.

props.name: editable
props.description: Steps can be dragged, reordered with Alt and the arrow keys, and renamed in draft.

props.name: showTimings
props.description: Estimates in draft, measured times while running and after.

props.name: speed
props.description: Playback multiplier for the run's clock. The plan's times stay real: 2 plays the same run in half the wall time.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: the approve, resume and retry buttons, and the active step's mark. Everything else is ink and grey.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black card with white ink, or the white inverse.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root element.

name: Agent Tool Call
description: One agent tool call as a flight-recorder line: mono tool name, argument summary, live duration and a status glyph that morphs through queued, running, done and failed.

props.name: seq
props.description: Position in the log, shown as a two-digit index on wide containers.

props.name: tool
props.description: Tool name, set in mono. read_file, web.search, bash and sql.query get realistic sample arguments, output and errors.

props.name: args
props.description: Flat arguments. Shown as a one-line summary and, expanded, as tinted JSON. Defaults to the sample for the tool.

props.name: status
props.description: Controlled status. Omit it to let the component track its own status, which Retry drives.

props.name: defaultStatus
props.description: Starting status when uncontrolled.

props.name: durationMs
props.description: Recorded duration once the call has finished. While it runs, the line counts live; without it, a finished call shows the time it was observed running.

props.name: result
props.description: Output of the call. Six lines show at first, with the rest one click away in a scroll area that keeps the page still.

props.name: stderr
props.description: Standard error. A failed call shows its last four lines beside a Retry button.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Whether the arguments and result panel starts open.

props.name: showTiming
props.description: Show the duration column.

props.name: density
props.description: Row height and type size. Compact fits a dense log; comfortable suits a single call on its own.

props.name: theme
props.description: The surface the line sits on, so its text, rules and tints keep their contrast.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the arc of a running call and the tint behind arguments. Light theme darkens it for text.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Runs on Retry. Return a promise to show the running state; it resolves to done and rejects to failed. Without it, an uncontrolled call reruns for 1.1 s, and a controlled call hides Retry because only the host can change its status.

props.name: retryLabel
props.description: Label on the retry button in a failed call.

props.name: retryingLabel
props.description: Label on the retry button while the retry runs. The button keeps its width, and the error above stays visible, dimmed, until the call lands.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.

name: Inline Citations
description: An AI answer with numbered markers on the baseline. Hover one to light the exact span it backs and open a source card; a rail groups duplicate sources.

props.name: question
props.default: "Why do teams cancel at their first renewal?"
props.description: The question the answer responds to, set in serif above the answer.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The question's heading level. Use h3 when the host page already owns the h2; the rail's Sources heading steps down with it.

props.name: answer
props.description: The answer as spans: { text, cite? }. Cited spans are highlighted when their marker is read. A cited span is marked by its last word, so the marker never wraps away from its claim.

props.name: sources
props.description: Retrieved sources in ranked order: { id, title, domain, monogram?, quote, match }. match must appear verbatim inside quote. Sources sharing a domain and title are grouped in the rail and share one marker number.

props.name: maxSources
props.description: How many sources, from the top of the list, may back the answer. Claims cited only to sources beyond it read as plain prose.

props.name: markerStyle
props.description: The marker on the baseline: a bare numeral, a 6px dot, or a boxed numeral chip.

props.name: showRail
props.description: Show the sources rail under the answer. Each source row quotes the sentences it backs and says how many claims that is; clicking a row pins its card on the first claim and moves focus there. The card names the other claims a source backs.

props.name: cardOnHover
props.description: Hovering a marker opens its source card, and moving to another marker glides the card there. The card is placed so it never covers another marker, and the pointer passes through an unpinned card. Off, a click opens and pins it, and the default hint says so. On touch the hint asks for a tap. A tap on another marker moves the card and pins it; a second tap on the pinned marker closes it. Escape closes a pinned card wherever focus is.

props.name: hint
props.description: The line under the answer that says how to read a source. Leave it out for the adaptive wording (hover, click, or tap on touch screens), pass your own copy, or pass false to hide it in a product view.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the highlighter wash behind a cited span, the active marker and the quote mark. A #rrggbb colour.

props.name: theme
props.description: Greyscale surfaces and ink. The accent stays the same in both themes.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.

name: Reasoning Trace
description: “Thought for 14s”, done properly: a ticking timer while thinking, a one-line summary that rewrites per step, and a dimmed trace that folds away when the reply starts.

props.name: state
props.description: Thinking shows the live timer, the rewriting summary and the steps as they arrive. Answering streams the reply in and the trace folds. Done is the finished card. The host drives it; the component never advances on its own.

props.name: trace
props.type: { summary: string; detail: string; atMs?: number }[]
props.description: Every step so far, in order. Summary is the one-line headline shown while the model is on it; detail is the dimmed line kept in the trace; atMs, when given, stamps the step's landing time as a quiet +0.6s. The trace region caps its height and scrolls, and follows the newest step while thinking.

props.name: answer
props.description: The reply so far, as paragraphs. Words settle in as they arrive; words already on screen when the card first renders stay put.

props.name: startedAt
props.description: When thinking began, as Date.now(). Starts the live timer. Without it the header shows the bare label, Thinking or Thought.

props.name: thoughtForMs
props.description: The final thinking time in milliseconds, for the Thought for label. Once the answer starts it wins over the time the card measured.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state for the trace. Pair it with onOpenChange to own the reader's choice yourself. When set, auto-collapse and rememberChoice no longer apply.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The open state before the reader or auto-collapse has spoken. Ignored when open is set.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the reader opens or closes the trace.

props.name: autoCollapse
props.description: Folds the trace away when the answer starts, unless the reader has chosen.

props.name: rememberChoice
props.description: Keeps the reader's open or closed choice across runs in this instance, so a reader who always wants the trace open is never folded again. Off, the choice lasts one run and auto-collapse applies at the next hand-off.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: Persists the reader's choice in localStorage under this key, so it survives reloads. Read after mount; storage errors are ignored. Implies rememberChoice.

props.name: showTimer
props.description: Shows the seconds in the header: live while thinking, frozen once done. Off keeps the bare label.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black surface with white ink, or the white inverse.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root section.

props.name: steps
props.description: Demo only. Default export only, not part of the component API. How many steps the scripted stream runs, from 3 to 12. Hosts pass their own trace.

props.name: speed
props.description: Demo only. Default export only, not part of the component API. Stream pace. 2 streams twice as fast and the timer reads the shorter time.

name: One-time Code
description: A dark one-time-code card: cells stagger in from blur, each digit settles, paste ripples, wrong codes shake away and success fuses the row into one Verified pill.

props.name: onVerify
props.description: Runs as soon as the last digit lands. Resolve { ok: true }, { ok: false, reason: "invalid", attemptsLeft }, { ok: false, reason: "expired" } or { ok: false, reason: "locked" }.

props.name: onResend
props.description: Sends a fresh code. The countdown restarts once it resolves.

props.name: onChangeDestination
props.description: Inline “Edit”: send a code to a new address. Resolve when sent.

props.name: onEdit
props.description: If set, “Edit” calls this instead of opening the inline editor.

props.name: onVerified
props.description: Called after the merge-to-pill animation settles.

props.name: length
props.description: Number of digits, split into two groups.

props.name: channel
props.description: Sets the glyph, heading and editor input type.

props.name: destination
props.description: Where the code went, shown in full.

props.name: title
props.description: Card heading.

props.name: description
props.default: "Enter the 6-digit code we just sent to"
props.description: Lead-in before the destination.

props.name: resendAfter
props.description: Seconds before Resend unlocks.

props.name: footnote
props.description: Fine print under the resend row.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the code on mount.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the active-cell ring, the caret, the Send button and the emphasised Resend after a lockout.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface palette. Both are tuned; success and error tones shift to stay AA.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.

name: SSO-Aware Sign-in
description: A dark work-email sign-in that reads the domain as you type: the password folds away, the button becomes Continue with Okta, shared domains get a picker.

props.name: detect
props.description: Look a domain up. [] keeps email + password; one workspace morphs to SSO; several show the picker. Defaults to a lookup in `directory`.

props.name: directory
props.description: Static domain → workspaces map used when `detect` is not given. Demo domains: acme.com, globex.com, contoso.com, initech.io.

props.name: debounceMs
props.description: Quiet time after the last keystroke before the domain is checked.

props.name: onSsoContinue
props.description: Start the redirect. The button shows redirect progress until it resolves; reject with an Error to show its message.

props.name: onPasswordSignIn
props.description: Password sign-in for non-SSO domains. Reject with an Error to show it under the password field.

props.name: email
props.description: Controlled email value. Pair with onEmailChange, or use defaultEmail.

props.name: defaultEmail
props.description: Initial email when uncontrolled.

props.name: onEmailChange
props.description: Called on every edit.

props.name: onForgotPassword
props.description: The “Forgot?” link.

props.name: brand
props.description: Product name beside the mark.

props.name: title
props.description: Card heading.

props.name: description
props.description: One line under the heading.

props.name: signUpHref
props.description: Target of the “Start a free trial” link.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the primary button and the selected workspace ring and dot. Provider marks keep their brand colours.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface palette. The light theme keeps the original warm-grey paper look.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.

controls.label: Subheading
controls.default: Use your work email. If your company signs in with SSO, we’ll send you the right way.

name: Dither Flow
description: A slowly advecting noise field rendered as an ordered Bayer 8×8 dither in two inks, like a risograph in motion. The pointer leaves a short wake of ink behind it.
usage:
import { BgDitherFlow } from "@/components/design-for-ai/bg-dither-flow";

Print, in motion.
// Children sit above the field, inside the quiet zone at the centre.

props.name: pixelSize
props.description: Dither cell size in CSS pixels, 1 to 8. Larger cells read as a coarser print.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Where the ink cut sits, 0 to 1. Lower floods the field with ink; higher leaves almost none.

props.name: quiet
props.description: How far the centre of the stage is held to paper, 0 to 1, so a headline sits on calm ground.

props.name: inkA
props.description: The dense ink, drawn where the field is heaviest. Light on dark paper, dark on light paper. Neutral by default.

props.name: inkB
props.description: The paper ink, drawn everywhere else. Also the root background, so an invalid value never shows a seam.

props.name: speed
props.description: Drift speed multiplier, 0 to 2. 0 holds the field still and stops the loop.

props.name: wake
props.description: Leave a short wake of ink behind the pointer. Off ignores the pointer entirely.

props.name: children
props.description: Content drawn above the field, such as a headline or a caption. Sits in the quiet zone at the centre.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which fills its parent. Give the parent a height.

name: Grain Light Field
description: A WebGL shaft of light falling across near-black, with fine film grain and one accent pooled in a corner. It leans toward the pointer and rests under reduced motion.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent, pooled in the bottom-right corner and kept there. Set accentAmount to 0 to turn it off.

props.name: accentAmount
props.description: How much of the accent pool shows, 0 to 1. At 0 the field is monochrome: light and ink only.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Brightness of the falling light, 0 to 1. It also scales the accent pool.

props.name: grain
props.description: Film grain strength, 0 to 1. The grain is a noise layer over the light, so it stays fine at every size.

props.name: speed
props.description: Drift and grain rate. 1 is the default pace; 0 holds the light and the grain still.

props.name: followPointer
props.description: Lean the light a little toward the mouse or pen. Touch never moves it, so a drag still scrolls the page.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze the light, its lean and the grain on the current frame.

props.name: children
props.description: Content layered over the field. The field sits behind it and never receives its layout.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root element, which fills its parent.

name: Magnetic CTA
description: A primary button that leans toward the pointer as it nears, with its label and arrow on separate depths and a soft light that tracks the cursor.

props.name: label
props.description: The action's label. A few words, in sentence case.

props.name: arrow
props.description: Shows an arrow after the label. The arrow sits on a nearer depth than the label, so the two move almost together and never collide.

props.name: strength
props.description: The furthest the button leans toward the pointer, in px. Capped at 8; 0 turns the lean off.

props.name: radius
props.description: Distance from the button edge, in px, at which the pull begins. It governs the pull only; the spotlight is sized from the button.

props.name: accent
props.description: The fill, as a hex colour. Unset, it is #e9e9eb on a dark surface and #0a0a0b (ink) on a light one. The label colour, spotlight and rim are chosen for contrast against it.

props.name: theme
props.description: The surface the button sits on. It sets the default fill, the drop shadow and the focus ring so each keeps its contrast.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Runs on click, after the press has been felt.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button. It stops leaning and drops to 40% opacity.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root, for layout such as margin, or alignment beside a secondary link.

name: Allocation Donut
description: A monochrome allocation donut that sweeps in and morphs between asset class, region and sector; the slice in focus takes the one accent.

props.name: views
props.type: { key: string; label: string; slices: AllocationSlice[] }[]
props.description: Groupings to switch between. Slices: { name, value, target?, change? }, up to 8, largest first so the ramp runs light to dark.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: Key of the view shown first; defaults to the first.

props.name: title
props.description: Card title.

props.name: tolerance
props.description: Drift in percentage points before a slice gets a drift chip.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: the hovered or focused slice, its legend swatch, weight bar and centre figure.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black card with a light-to-dark grey ramp, or a white card with a dark-to-light ramp.

props.name: palette
props.description: Slice colours in order. Keep them neutral: the accent marks the slice in focus.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO currency for values.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for number formatting.

name: Candlestick Chart
description: A trading-desk candlestick chart that grows in candle by candle, with a snapping crosshair, two averages, live ticks, pinch zoom and a range navigator.

props.name: data
props.description: Candles per interval: { t: epoch ms, o, h, l, c, v }, oldest first. Missing intervals fall back to demo data.

props.name: defaultInterval
props.description: Interval selected on mount.

props.name: name
props.description: Asset name in the header.

props.name: pair
props.description: Pair shown in the mono chip.

props.name: venue
props.description: Exchange or data source, hidden in narrow containers.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO currency for the headline price.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for numbers and dates.

props.name: maFast
props.description: Fast moving-average period. 0 hides it.

props.name: maSlow
props.description: Slow moving-average period. 0 hides it.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in px; plots under 560px wide use 70%.

props.name: live
props.description: Tick the last candle every 1.4s. Ignored under reduced motion.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one non-data colour: the fast moving average.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black card with white ink, or a white card with near-black ink. Up and down colours adjust for contrast.

name: Channel Breakdown
description: A dark ranked breakdown: a share strip grows segment by segment, rows land with counting figures, bars fill, and switching period re-sorts rows on a spring.

props.name: periods
props.type: { key: string; label: string; caption?: string; channels: { name: string; value: number; previous?: number }[] }[]
props.description: One entry per period. Channels are ranked by value; shares are computed from the period total. previous adds a small delta.

props.name: defaultPeriod
props.description: Period key shown first.

props.name: onPeriodChange
props.description: Called when the period changes.

props.name: title
props.description: Label above the total.

props.name: format
props.description: How values and the total are written.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the leading channel's segment and bar. The rest step down a grey ramp.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface palette.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO currency code.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for figures.

name: Revenue Trend
description: A dark period-over-period area chart: the line strokes in, its fill rises from the baseline, the total counts up and a spring crosshair reads any day.

props.name: data
props.description: Daily values, oldest first (ISO dates). Supply at least twice the longest range so every range has a previous period to compare with.

props.name: ranges
props.type: { key: string; label: string; days: number }[]
props.description: Range switcher options. The switcher hides with one range.

props.name: defaultRange
props.description: Range key shown first.

props.name: onRangeChange
props.description: Called when the range changes.

props.name: title
props.description: Metric name above the total.

props.name: unit
props.description: Muted suffix after the title.

props.name: format
props.description: How figures and axis labels are written.

props.name: decimals
props.description: Fraction digits for the total and tooltip.

props.name: aggregate
props.description: Whether the headline is the period's total or its mean.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: this period's line, fill and crosshair dot. Monochrome by default.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface palette.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO currency code.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for every figure.

name: Async Combobox
description: A combobox over a remote source: skeleton rows while it loads, stale results dimmed rather than cleared, a Create row when nothing matches and recent picks when empty.

props.name: label
props.description: Mono label above the field, and the accessible name of the list.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Field placeholder, shown while the field is empty. Pass the noun your list holds, e.g. "Search clients…".

props.name: search
props.description: Your remote source. A newer query aborts the older request, so the last query typed always wins. Left out, the built-in demo directory answers after latency.

props.name: latency
props.description: Milliseconds the built-in directory takes to answer. Ignored when search is passed.

props.name: offline
props.description: Make the built-in directory fail every query, to show the designed error state. Ignored when search is passed.

props.name: debounce
props.default: 150 with search, 0 for the built-in directory
props.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last keystroke before the source is asked, so a fast typist sends one request, not nine. The skeleton or stale state shows during the wait.

props.name: allowCreate
props.description: Offer “Create ‘name’” when a search finds nothing.

props.name: onCreate
props.description: Called with the name as it is shown when the Create row is chosen: trimmed, spaces collapsed, a lowercase entry capitalised. That name is also the new item's label, and the item is picked straight away.

props.name: recent
props.description: Show recent picks on an empty query, and as a fallback under a search that finds nothing. Reopening a single choice lists them with the choice checked.

props.name: recentItems
props.description: Recent picks at first render. Each pick moves to the front (in multiple mode, once the list closes); three are kept.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Pick several options. Each becomes a removable token inside the field, and the list stays open.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Line shown when a search finds nothing.

props.name: resultsLabel
props.description: Heading over the matches. Set it to the noun your list holds, such as "Clients".

props.name: recentLabel
props.description: Heading over recent picks, on an empty query and under a search that finds nothing.

props.name: createLabel
props.description: The verb on the Create row: “Create ‘Northwind’”.

props.name: createHint
props.description: Mono hint on the right of the Create row. Hidden below a 384px container, so it never truncates on phones.

props.name: idleText
props.description: Line shown on an empty query when there are no recent picks to list.

props.name: errorText
props.description: Line shown when the source fails.

props.name: retryText
props.description: The action on the failure line that asks the source again.

props.name: defaultQuery
props.description: Text in the field on first render.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Open the list on first render.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the whole selection whenever it changes: a pick, a removed token or a cleared choice.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the Create action. Nothing else is coloured.

props.name: accentInk
props.description: Ink on the Create tile's plus glyph. Use dark ink for a light accent and light ink for a dark one.

props.name: theme
props.description: Greyscale palette for the field, the sheet and the stage.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.

controls.label: Empty copy
controls.default: Nothing in the directory matches that.

name: KPI Cards
description: A dark row of selectable KPI cards: figures count up out of a blur, sparklines stroke in, deltas tick, and a 7/30/90-day switch re-counts and morphs every card.

props.name: periods
props.type: { key: string; label: string; caption?: string; stats: KpiStat[] }[]
props.description: One entry per range. Each stat is { key, label, value, previous, format?: "currency" | "number" | "percent", decimals?, series: number[], invert? }. The switcher hides with a single period.

props.name: defaultPeriod
props.description: Period key shown first.

props.name: period
props.description: Controlled period key. Pair it with onPeriodChange, or omit it and use defaultPeriod to let the switch manage it.

props.name: onPeriodChange
props.description: Called when the period switch changes.

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled selected stat key, e.g. the metric a neighbouring chart shows. Omit to let the cards manage it.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Initially selected stat when uncontrolled.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with a stat key when a card is pressed.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading above the row.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: selection ring, selected sparkline and dot. Monochrome by default.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface palette.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO currency for currency stats.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for every figure.

name: Orders Table
description: A dark recent-orders table: rows rise in with drawn avatar rings and counting totals, status tabs re-filter on a spring, and it folds into cards in narrow columns.

props.name: orders
